fold.norm: input/post/final RMSNorm affine weights fused into consumers (q/k/v; gate_up and router; lm_head), then set to one
fold.r1: global residual rotation; folded into q/k/v, every expert's gate_up input axis, the router's input axis, and the output axes of o_proj and every expert's down_proj
fold.r2: per-head V rotation with identical fold into every GQA-expanded o_proj head block
fold.r4: per-expert down-input rotation folded into that expert's down_proj rows
fold.router: R1 folded into the gate's input columns; routing logits unchanged in exact arithmetic; router kept unquantized
